summary: This drug includes warnings to avoid contact with the eyes, keep out of reach of children, and get immediate medical help if it is swallowed [3]. Users should stop using it and consult a doctor if their symptoms get worse or continue for more than 7 days [3]. The product also contains almond allergens and is meant only for external use on the skin [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model rather than human testing show a low risk score for the liver and heart [M].
